items.title: New student visa rules introduce extra fees for course changes and crack down on onshore applications - SBS
items.commentary: New rules for international student visas introduce additional fees for those who change courses and tighten requirements for applications lodged from within Australia. Students planning to switch providers or apply onshore may face higher costs and stricter conditions.
items.commentary_pt: Novas regras para o visto de estudante internacional passam a cobrar taxas extras de quem troca de curso e endurecem as exigências para pedidos feitos de dentro da Austrália. Estudantes que pretendem mudar de instituição ou solicitar o visto já estando no país podem enfrentar custos mais altos e condições mais rígidas.

items.title: Top News: Backpacker visa cuts gone too far, opposition says - SBS
items.commentary: The opposition has criticised cuts to the working holiday (backpacker) visa program, arguing they go too far. The proposed reductions could limit the number of young travellers able to work in Australia, affecting sectors that rely on this labour.
items.commentary_pt: A oposição criticou os cortes no programa de visto de férias e trabalho (backpacker), afirmando que foram longe demais. As reduções previstas podem diminuir o número de jovens viajantes autorizados a trabalhar na Austrália, impactando setores que dependem dessa mão de obra.

items.title: Taylor to slash migration by two-thirds in bid to rival One Nation - smh.com.au
items.commentary: A proposal has been put forward to reduce Australia's migration intake by about two-thirds. If adopted, such a cut would significantly reduce the number of available places across visa categories, making it harder to secure permanent and skilled migration.
items.commentary_pt: Surgiu uma proposta para reduzir em cerca de dois terços o número de imigrantes admitidos na Austrália. Se aprovada, a medida diminuiria de forma significativa as vagas disponíveis nas diferentes categorias de visto, tornando mais difícil obter residência permanente e migração qualificada.

items.title: New international student visa restrictions hit as changing education providers gets costly - SBS
items.commentary: New restrictions on international student visas make changing education providers more expensive. Students who wish to transfer institutions will now face additional costs, which may affect those seeking to adjust their study plans.
items.commentary_pt: Novas restrições ao visto de estudante internacional tornam mais caro trocar de instituição de ensino. Quem quiser transferir de escola ou universidade passará a arcar com custos adicionais, o que pode afetar estudantes que desejam ajustar seus planos de estudo.

items.title: Government targets lawyers, agents in migration crackdown - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: The government has announced a crackdown targeting lawyers and migration agents accused of exploiting the visa system. The measures aim to curb improper practices and could change how applicants receive professional assistance with their visa processes.
items.commentary_pt: O governo anunciou uma ofensiva contra advogados e agentes de migração acusados de explorar o sistema de vistos. As medidas buscam coibir práticas irregulares e podem alterar a forma como os solicitantes recebem assessoria profissional em seus processos de visto.

items.title: Labor targets ‘visa hopping’ international students in crackdown on ‘permanently temporary’ migration - The Guardian
items.commentary: The government is targeting 'visa hopping' by international students who repeatedly extend their stay through successive temporary visas. The crackdown aims to reduce the number of people remaining in Australia long-term on temporary status, potentially limiting options to prolong a stay.
items.commentary_pt: O governo passou a combater o chamado 'visa hopping', prática de estudantes internacionais que prolongam a permanência encadeando sucessivos vistos temporários. A ofensiva busca reduzir o número de pessoas que permanecem no país por longos períodos em situação temporária, o que pode limitar as opções de estender a estadia.

items.title: New student visa crackdown comes with extra cost for course-switchers - SBS
items.commentary: A new crackdown on student visas introduces extra costs for those who switch courses during their studies. Students who change programs will now face additional fees, affecting the financial planning of those already in Australia.
items.commentary_pt: Uma nova ofensiva sobre os vistos de estudante traz custos extras para quem muda de curso durante os estudos. Estudantes que alterarem o programa passarão a pagar taxas adicionais, o que afeta o planejamento financeiro de quem já está na Austrália.

items.title: Labor's working holiday visa policy risks regional seats, experts say - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Experts warn that changes to the working holiday visa policy could reduce the availability of backpacker labour in regional areas. The adjustments may affect young travellers' ability to work in rural and remote Australia, where such workers are often essential.
items.commentary_pt: Especialistas alertam que mudanças na política do visto de férias e trabalho podem reduzir a oferta de mão de obra de backpackers em áreas regionais. Os ajustes podem afetar a capacidade de jovens viajantes de trabalhar em regiões rurais e remotas da Austrália, onde esses trabalhadores costumam ser essenciais.

items.title: Labor crackdown over 'futile' visa cases - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: The government has moved to crack down on what it describes as 'futile' visa cases that clog the review and appeals system. The measures could reduce avenues for prolonged appeals, affecting applicants who rely on review processes to extend their stay.
items.commentary_pt: O governo adotou medidas para coibir o que classifica como processos de visto 'inúteis' que sobrecarregam o sistema de recursos e revisões. As ações podem reduzir as vias para recursos prolongados, afetando solicitantes que recorrem a esses processos para estender sua permanência.

items.title: Worker visa limbo, a coroner's inquest into missing men, and timeless tales of the Eyre Highway - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: A report highlights uncertainty faced by workers caught in visa limbo while awaiting decisions. The situation leaves some migrant workers unable to plan their futures, underscoring delays and instability in parts of the visa system.
items.commentary_pt: Uma reportagem aborda a incerteza enfrentada por trabalhadores presos em limbo de visto enquanto aguardam decisões. A situação deixa alguns imigrantes impossibilitados de planejar o futuro, evidenciando atrasos e instabilidade em partes do sistema de vistos.

items.title: Minister says lawyers are 'gaming' visa rules - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: A government minister has accused some lawyers of 'gaming' visa rules to prolong clients' stays in Australia. The statement signals potential tighter oversight of migration advisers and possible changes to how visa applications and appeals are handled.
items.commentary_pt: Um ministro do governo acusou alguns advogados de 'manipular' as regras de visto para prolongar a permanência de seus clientes na Austrália. A declaração sinaliza uma possível fiscalização mais rígida sobre os consultores de migração e eventuais mudanças na forma como pedidos e recursos de visto são tratados.

items.title: Labor will go after lawyers trying to 'game' the visa system - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: The government has announced it will pursue lawyers accused of 'gaming' the visa system. The planned action targets improper practices by advisers and may affect how applicants are represented in visa matters.
items.commentary_pt: O governo anunciou que vai agir contra advogados acusados de 'manipular' o sistema de vistos. A medida planejada mira práticas irregulares de consultores e pode afetar a forma como os solicitantes são representados em questões de visto.

items.title: ‘Sharp practices’ by rogue migration lawyers in Labor’s crosshairs - smh.com.au
items.commentary: The government has set its sights on so-called 'sharp practices' by rogue migration lawyers. The initiative aims to curb misconduct among advisers, which could change the standards applicants must consider when choosing professional representation.
items.commentary_pt: O governo colocou em sua mira as chamadas 'práticas abusivas' de advogados de migração mal-intencionados. A iniciativa busca conter condutas irregulares entre os consultores, o que pode alterar os critérios que os solicitantes precisam considerar ao escolher representação profissional.

items.title: Businesses fear visa changes to backpacker visas will make staffing harder - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Businesses have expressed concern that changes to backpacker (working holiday) visas will make it harder to find staff. The adjustments could reduce the pool of available workers, affecting employers who depend on this type of labour.
items.commentary_pt: Empresas manifestaram preocupação de que mudanças no visto de backpacker (férias e trabalho) dificultarão a contratação de funcionários. Os ajustes podem reduzir o número de trabalhadores disponíveis, prejudicando empregadores que dependem desse tipo de mão de obra.

items.title: Remote businesses fear working holiday visa changes will mean fewer 'essential' backpackers - ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
items.commentary: Remote businesses fear that changes to the working holiday visa will result in fewer backpackers considered essential to their operations. The policy shift could affect staffing in remote regions that rely heavily on these temporary workers.
items.commentary_pt: Empresas de regiões remotas temem que mudanças no visto de férias e trabalho resultem em menos backpackers, considerados essenciais para suas operações. A alteração na política pode afetar a contratação em áreas remotas que dependem fortemente desses trabalhadores temporários.
